about: The wire facts of the signed-request ingress that crates/busbar/tests/signed_ingress_boundary.rs boots the shipped binary over. The test names no dialect, scheme, vendor header or configuration word itself: it reads them here. dialect is the provider protocol whose clients sign each request; refusal_cell is the 1.5.5 oracle cell whose recorded answer (status, body, headers) the refusals must equal. The templates take {placeholders} the test fills.
config_template:
listen: "127.0.0.1:{data_port}"
admin_listen: "127.0.0.1:{admin_port}"
store: {module: memory}
advanced:
  allow_destinations: ["127.0.0.1"]
admin_require_mtls: false
identity-providers:
  {operator}:
    module: {operator}
    token: { env: BUSBAR_ADMIN_TOKEN }
auth:
  chain: [keys]
  signing_key: { file: "{signing}" }
  admin_auth:
    - {operator}
providers:
  lane:
    api_key: { env: {creds_env} }
models:
  {model}:
    provider: lane
    upstream_model: "{wire_model}"
